An Inverter converts DC to AC, while the Onboard Charger converts incoming AC for the battery. Recovery and charging depend on vehicle design and conditions.

Tamper Proof is the inherited label for tamper resistance, not an absolute guarantee against interference. The guide describes Lockout as trained hazardous-energy control under applicable procedures. Certification addresses specified requirements, and Warranty states agreed coverage. An emergency stop alone does not establish isolation of every energy source.
Explain the difference between Charging Speed and Time Remaining using the account above.
